newsitem.title: USA: Southwestern Bell launches wireless in Ark.
newsitem.headline: Southwestern Bell launches wireless in Ark.

text.p: Southwestern Bell said on Thursday it launched its wireless communications services statewide in Arkansas.
In August, the company said it signed an agreement with AT&T Corp's AT&T Wireless to take control of Arkansas' cellular licenses and networks, which cover a total population of 2.3 million people.
Southwestern Bell is a subsidiary of SBC Communications.

Southwestern Bell said the agreement paved the way for it to become a single-source provider of landline network and wireless telecommunications services, including long-distance cellular. It said it would retain virtually all of the 130 former AT&T Arkansas wireless employees and honor the company's existing wireless service agreements.
